standard.summary: SafeGuard 实时监控训练健康状态：检测 NaN loss、梯度异常、loss spike、学习率死锁，并在检测到问题时自动恢复（降低 lr、跳过 bad sample 等）。
standard.effect: so_enable_nan_detection 每 N 步检查 loss 是否为 NaN；so_enable_loss_spike_detection 检测 loss 突然飙升（>10x 正常值）；so_enable_lr_deadlock_detection 检测 lr 是否已衰减到无效水平。
standard.whenToUse: 始终推荐开启。是训练安全的最后一道防线。默认就是开启的。
standard.avoidWhen: 不需要关闭。开销极小（每 N 步做一次简单检查）。

standard_en.summary: SafeGuard monitors training health in real time: it detects NaN loss, gradient anomalies, loss spikes and learning-rate deadlock, and recovers automatically when it finds a problem (lowering the lr, skipping a bad sample and so on).
standard_en.effect: so_enable_nan_detection checks every N steps whether the loss is NaN; so_enable_loss_spike_detection detects a sudden loss surge (>10x the normal value); so_enable_lr_deadlock_detection detects whether the lr has decayed to an ineffective level.
standard_en.whenToUse: Always recommended. It is the last line of defence for training safety, and it is on by default.
standard_en.avoidWhen: No need to turn it off. The overhead is tiny (one simple check every N steps).

advanced.principle: NaN 检测：检查 loss tensor 是否包含 NaN/Inf。Loss spike：维护 loss 的滑动窗口均值和标准差，当前 loss > mean + threshold * std 时判定为 spike。LR 死锁：连续 N 步 lr < threshold 时判定为死锁。自动恢复：lr *= reduction_factor，或跳过当前 batch。so_enable_bad_sample_culling 将连续导致 NaN 的样本移到 quarantine_dir。
advanced.intervention: 在 training_step 的 loss 计算后插入检查逻辑。检测到问题时：(1) 记录事件到 safeguard_events.jsonl；(2) 执行恢复动作；(3) 如果连续失败超过 max_nan_count 则 abort 训练。
advanced.expectedImpact: 防止训练因 NaN/spike 而静默失败。不改善正常训练的质量，但在异常情况下挽救训练。
advanced.tradeoffs: so_gradient_scan_mode 控制梯度检查的粒度：batched 最快，foreach 最精确，off 禁用。

advanced_en.principle: NaN detection: checks whether the loss tensor contains NaN/Inf. Loss spike: maintains a sliding-window mean and standard deviation of loss; the current loss > mean + threshold * std counts as a spike. LR deadlock: lr < threshold for N consecutive steps counts as a deadlock. Automatic recovery: lr *= reduction_factor, or skip the current batch. so_enable_bad_sample_culling moves samples that repeatedly cause NaN into quarantine_dir.
advanced_en.intervention: Inserts check logic after the loss computation in training_step. When a problem is detected: (1) record the event to safeguard_events.jsonl; (2) execute the recovery action; (3) if consecutive failures exceed max_nan_count, abort training.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Prevents training from failing silently due to NaN/spikes. Does not improve normal training quality but rescues the run in abnormal situations.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: so_gradient_scan_mode controls gradient-check granularity: batched is fastest, foreach most precise, off disables.
